name: Pepsales AI
description: Reduce your sales cycle and crush your quota
content: **Hey Product Hunt Community! 👋**I'm Ajay Singh, Co-founder and CEO of Pepsales AI, and I’m really excited to share what we’ve been building with all of you.**Why did we build Pepsales AI?**If you’ve worked in B2B sales, you know how chaotic discovery and demo calls can be.- Reps often miss key signals, forget next steps, and fail to follow up effectively.- Managers don’t get visibility into what actually happened.- CRMs are still incomplete and out of sync with reality.**We kept asking ourselves:** Why does sales still feel like a guessing game?**That’s why we built Pepsales AI** - A real-time co-pilot that helps sales teams sell smarter, not harder.Whether it’s live call coaching, deal qualification, or capturing buyer intent, Pepsales gives reps and managers exactly what they need, right when they need it.**What is Pepsales AI?**Pepsales AI is a live conversation intelligence platform that turns every sales call into a revenue opportunity.It works across **Zoom, Google Meet,** and **Microsoft Teams,** and integrates seamlessly with **Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, and Other CRMs.****Here’s what it does:****📞 Live Call Intelligence**Guides reps in real time with smart prompts based on what the buyer is actually saying.**📝 Structured Post-Call Summaries**Automatically captures qualification data, objections, blockers, action items, and next steps.**🎯 Automated Lead Scoring**Applies MEDDPICC, BANT, SPIN, or your custom sales framework to every deal. No extra effort from reps.**📊 Pipeline Visibility**See where every deal stands, what's missing, and which ones are at risk. All in one dashboard.**📈 Performance Insights**Coach reps based on actual conversations, not memory. Spot patterns in discovery, objection handling, and follow-up.**🗣️ Voice of the Prospect Analytics**Capture and analyze real buyer concerns across your pipeline - pricing, compliance, competitors, and more.**Who is Pepsales AI for?**- **Sales leaders** who want better forecasting and deal visibility- **Account executives** who want to focus on selling, not admin- **Sales enablement teams** that need consistency across reps- **GTM and product teams** looking to stay close to buyer feedback**Why teams love it:**✅ 50 percent increase in demo-to-close conversion✅ Reps ramp in weeks, not quarters✅ Blockers and objections are flagged early✅ Product and marketing teams finally hear what buyers actually care about**Pepsales AI** is trusted by sales teams at companies like **Spyne, Hubilo, Vespa, and Fireflink**, and we’re backed by **Chiratae Ventures** and **GTM leaders** from India and the Bay Area.We’d love your feedback!We're incredibly proud of what we’ve built, and we believe this is how modern sales teams should operate - live, data-driven, and buyer-aligned.If you're building or scaling a B2B sales motion, we’d love your thoughts, feedback, and support.**Thank you for checking us out!**

name: Vogent Voicelab
content: We’re excited to launch Vogent Voicelab (vogent.ai/voicelab): an optimized API to run top open-source voice models.    New open-source text-to-speech models come out every week, with many ranking as state-of-the-art on popular benchmarks.    However, most of these models are not readily usable for high-volume, low-latency inference. Additionally, some research preview models can struggle with hallucinations and inconsistent outputs. Finally, as with any model, hosting yourself and managing compute can be a headache.    Voicelab solves these problems:- Voicelab maintains a proprietary inference stack that is optimized to serve text-to-speech transformers efficiently and scalably.- Voicelab post-trains select models to improve consistency and offer high-quality professional voice clones.- Voicelab manages all compute, so you can pay for these models per-character instead of managing GPUs.  All of this is exposed through a standard text-to-speech API (with streaming/websocket support) and an online playground.        Docs: docs.vogent.ai/voicelab        TTS Playground: app.vogent.ai
